items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It was more like the master, like Ray Brown could just take one hand and (scats solo).

ctx.x: Oh, great bass player. Underrated. He's from that Ron Carter mold. Ron look, later developed this technique of soloing and getting his things, you know, he didn't have to do Paul Chambers’ style with those and all that (scats frenetic bass
solo). He didn’t have to go there. It was more like the master, like Ray Brown could just take one hand and (scats solo). He was telling stories, and painting pictures.
